entries.positive_observation: The compact yellow mascot retains the right-facing near-profile head and rightward gaze, with green-ringed solid black eyes, one restrained closed mouth, and no human nose, ears or skin. The dark olive peaked cap keeps its shiny visor, gold piping/cord, upper gold eagle and separate lower red-centered gold wreath/cockade. Short dark-brown temple hair, narrow sideburns and both brown eyebrows remain; the chin is clean-shaven and there are no glasses or moustache. The original upright crop, directional modeling and deep visor shadow remain recognizable. The dark olive uniform retains two red gold-emblem collar patches, gold shoulder boards, a white pointed shirt collar and dark tie largely behind one black-and-silver neck cross. The rounded chin has a short broad transition into a naturally fitted collar without pinching, floating cloth, clipping or a cream bib. The pale muted gray-olive/greige backplate remains complete across the original opaque rectangle, with no frame, note, halo or replacement scene.
entries.alpha_decision: visible-alpha-v1: the exact source is RGBA 156x210 with alpha extrema [255,255] and all 32760 pixels at alpha 255. The full white/cyan/source-alpha sheet and complete unchanged RGB raw show a continuous opaque backplate and solid clothing with no holes, smoke, halo or transparent exterior. The returned 1776x2368 master is RGB, so returned_alpha_extrema is null and no native_alpha_accepted claim applies. RGB art is approved only for the later source-compatible BILINEAR alpha-only restoration of this fully opaque source alpha, followed by a separate final visual review. No repair was performed in this review.
entries.visible_limitations: The fine cap and collar insignia, exact shoulder-board embroidery and small neck-cross interior cannot be resolved completely at 156x210. Their visible counts, positions and broad shapes were checked without inventing finer detail; those resolution limits are not rejection grounds.
